R05_preroll_sweep.method: white-noise analysis input, Mix 100%, Wiener deconvolution 40 ms Hann / 20 ms hop; swoosh peak = a tap arriving at 0 ms (step in the zero-lag energy share; main tap step >= 0.25, minor tap 0.10-0.25); departures are the same test in reversed time
R05_preroll_sweep.selection: exactly one main-tap arrival in [section_start, clear_until) and it lies in the window; then fewest other main-tap arrivals/departures more than 0.3 s from it, fewest minor arrivals, closest to the window centre
